official: 稲城市国民健康保険税条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 国保税に子育て支援分を新設
summary: 現在の国民健康保険税は、基礎課税分や後期高齢者支援金等課税分などで構成されています。2026年度分から子ども・子育て支援納付金課税額を新設し、税率や均等割額、軽減額などを改めます。この条例は2026年4月1日に施行されます。
changes: 子ども・子育て支援納付金課税額を新設し、所得割率を0.3%、加入者1人あたりの額を1,820円、18歳以上の加入者に加える額を110円とし、上限を3万円にする
基礎課税額と後期高齢者支援金等課税額の所得割率・均等割額を改める
子ども・子育て支援納付金課税額について、18歳未満被保険者の均等割額を全額減額し、未就学児や出産被保険者などの軽減を設ける
低所得世帯などの軽減額と、普通徴収の分割額の端数処理を改める
who: 稲城市の国民健康保険加入世帯
why: 子ども・子育て支援納付金を医療保険料とあわせて賦課・徴収することと、国民健康保険運営協議会の答申を受けた条例改正が必要なためと、市は説明しています。

notes: code: copied from the source (36 chars): 「、被保険者均等割額を1,820円、18歳以上被保険者均等割額を110円と」

en.name: Adds a child and child-rearing support component to national health insurance tax
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Inagi City National Health Insurance Tax Ordinance
en.summary: At present, National Health Insurance tax consists of a basic tax component and a component for contributions supporting the healthcare system for older people, among other items. Starting with FY2026, the city will introduce a tax amount for the child and child-rearing support contribution and revise tax rates, per-member amounts, reductions, and other items. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Introduces a child and child-rearing support contribution tax component, with an income-based rate of 0.3%, an amount of ¥1,820 per enrolled member, an additional ¥110 for each enrolled member aged 18 or older, and a cap of ¥30,000
Revises the income-based rates and per-member amounts for the basic tax component and the late-stage elderly support contribution tax component

Reduces the per-member amount for this contribution tax component to zero for insured members under 18, and introduces reductions for preschool-age children and insured members who give birth, among others
Revises reductions for low-income households and the handling of fractional amounts in installment payments by direct collection
who: Households enrolled in Inagi City National Health Insurance
Insured members under 18, preschool-age children, and insured members who give birth
Low-income households and people paying in installments by direct collection
en.why: The city says the ordinance needs to be amended because the child and child-rearing support contribution will be assessed and collected together with medical insurance premiums, and because an amendment is needed in response to a recommendation from the National Health Insurance Management Council.
